name: spice
description: An unofficial GitHub presence of JPL's NAIF's SPICE toolkit, combining the per-platform source releases (Visual Studio, Linux, macOS, Cygwin) into a single source tree of common and platform-specific files.

This port lives inside the Spice repository and builds the enclosing checkout. When publishing Spice to a registry, replace the path-based source in the portfile with vcpkg_from_github(REPO OpenSpace/Spice REF <tag> SHA512 <hash>).
Spice has no dependencies of its own, so there is no manifest to keep in sync, unlike the ghoul and sgct overlay ports.
